summary: Updated 4-Pillar Forge MVP Plan incorporating the PM Lesson & Mascot UX Redesign: complete eradication of all 'ELI5' terminology, moving the Audio Voice Player and Live Code Sandbox Drawer into the top LessonShell header bar, replacing the heavy 4-tab top banner with clean contextual Forge Buddy speech bubbles by step type (Joke/Analogy on intro steps, Interview Trap on code/practice steps, and inline reactions on answers/errors), plus Dashboard Interview Readiness, Creative Atelier Mock Interview Simulator, and Zero-Setup Project Builder.
